title: Timeouts and 5xx on recommendation-service
description: Customers report missing or slow product recommendations on the home page. recommendation-service shows elevated latency and intermittent 5xx responses.
root_cause_detail: A configuration change reduced the recommendation-service connection pool from 15 to 5 connections; normal traffic exhausted the pool.
expected_symptoms: connection acquisition timeouts and database errors in recommendation-service logs
recommendation-service p95 latency rises from ~89ms to ~3.9s
recommendation-service memory stays near baseline; CPU at most moderately elevated
configuration reload on recommendation-service shortly before saturation; database server connections drop
resolution: Reverted the pool size configuration and added validation for datasource settings.
